title: spiesia heterotricha
intro: Spiesia heterotricha, commonly known as Indian valerian, is a plant species in the genus Spiesia, used as a medicinal herb. This plant is known for its sedative properties, which can help alleviate stress, anxiety, and insomnia. The health benefits of Spiesia heterotricha include its ability to reduce inflammation and improve sleep quality. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its sedative, antispasmodic, and anti-inflammatory effects, primarily attributed to its bioactive constituents such as valerenic acid, valepotriates, and isovaleric acid.
